name: MyFitnessPal
subtitle: AI Coach & Nutrition Tracker
description:
Eat better, train smarter, and hit your goals with MyFitnessPal, the calorie counter and nutrition tracker with a built-in AI Coach. Join the millions of users who've created over 100 billion food logs and counting! Calories, macros, food, workouts – track it all in one place with one of the most comprehensive health & fitness tracker apps available. Your new AI Coach gives you personalized guidance based on your goals and history. Plus GLP-1 journey support – log doses and set reminders.

Set personalized fitness, nutrition, and healthy eating goals. Build better habits by tracking calories, macros, and water intake. Download the app & start your free Premium trial today. With MyFitnessPal, you get healthy food inspiration, an intermittent fasting tracker, science-backed nutrition, and powerful workout logging tools. MyFitnessPal is the #1 nutrition, macro & calorie counter app in the U.S. – as featured in the New York Times, Forbes, the Today Show & U.S. News & World Report.

More than a calorie counter & nutrition journal – MyFitnessPal is an AI-powered health & fitness tracker with an AI Coach, built to help you track macros, monitor nutrition progress & crush your fitness goals.

NEW FEATURE: AI COACH
■ Your personal AI Coach delivers nutrition insights tailored to your goals, habits, and logging history
■ Ask the AI Coach about your nutrition, macros & workouts

CALORIE, NUTRITION & GLP-1 TRACKER
■ Log meals effortlessly from 20.5M+ foods, including restaurant dishes – calorie counting made simple
■ Full nutrition & macro tracker breakdown – carbs, fat & protein – with custom targets for protein, sodium, fiber & more
■ Get AI Coach tips to stay on track with your nutrition & macro goals
■ Stay hydrated with the built-in water tracker
■ Log how you feel on your GLP-1 medications to spot patterns in symptoms & side effects
■ Stick to your schedule with custom medication reminders
■ Build healthy habits that stick with simple nutrition & medication tracking

FITNESS TRACKER & WORKOUT LOGGING
■ Log every workout & steps with our workout tracker to monitor fitness progress & calorie burn
■ See how your workouts and diet affect your nutrition, macros & goals
■ Get AI Coach guidance to make your workouts and healthy eating work together
■ Wear OS support – calorie counter, workout tracker, water tracker & macro tracker on your wrist. Add complications to the home screen for faster logging and the tile for tracking nutrients at a glance

PERSONALIZED FITNESS, NUTRITION & HEALTHY EATING TOOLS
■ Customize your nutrition, macro & fitness goals – weight loss, gain, maintenance, or performance
■ Personalized health & nutrition dashboard with your workout & calorie stats in one place
■ Save healthy meals & recipes for quick calorie counter & macro logging
■ Meal planner to help you hit your nutrition & macro targets
■ Connect 40+ fitness trackers, smartwatches & health apps in one unified ecosystem

PREMIUM
■ Faster calorie counting with barcode scan, meal scan & voice logging
■ Customized macro, calorie & nutrition goals tailored to your fitness targets
■ Ad-free logging with built-in insights & calorie and macro progress comparisons
■ Net Carbs Mode for keto and low-carb diets

PREMIUM PLUS
■ All Premium features, plus full nutrition-focused meal planning
■ Personalized meal plans, integrated grocery delivery & smart calorie counter tools
■ 1500+ recipes tailored to your calorie, nutrition, macro & fitness goals

MyFitnessPal is the leading health & fitness tracker app with an AI Coach to help you conquer your calorie, nutrition & healthy eating goals.
